window.notes: The 750 rows around the CPZ level load of the committed CPZ level-select recording, a different route and a different zone's music epoch from the complete run. Recaptured for the two-site observer: the 33 SFX transfers are unchanged and the two additions come from sndDriverInput's music store at loc_10C0 (s2.asm:1302-1304). Row 2724 is 8Eh, the CPZ music load, which zCurSong takes one service later; row 3225 is B5h, the ring the hundred-ring milestone check plays through PlayMusic rather than PlaySound (:25913-25914), which the single-site observer could not see. Recaptured for the two-site observer: every transfer now carries an explicit site, and the music site observes the store at loc_10C0 (docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:1302-1304), which move.b D0,$09(A1,D1.w) at 0x10D6 never reaches. The capture is bounded to this window, so source_first_row and source_exclusive_end are the window's own bounds.

production_bound_meaning: The payload's own metadata line carries production_bound:false and that value is preserved verbatim. This fixture is a committed comparison reference and binds nothing to a production producer. Nothing here hydrates engine state: it is comparison-only, MEASUREMENT_ONLY at the gate.
